record.question: At the present population growth rate, in which year India is likely to takeover China as the world most populous country?
record.explanation: Population projections at the 2021-2022 growth rate put India ahead of China in the mid-2020s, and 2025 is the option closest to that estimate. The exact crossover year depends on the projection used.
